edits.find: delivered to the Recipient within ten (10) days
edits.comment: Ten days to confirm oral disclosures in writing is short. Aligned to the standard's longer confirmation window.
edits.issue: Ten-day written confirmation of oral disclosures

edits.insert: , after giving the Disclosing Party prompt written notice where legally permitted
edits.comment: Notice to the other party before a compelled disclosure was missing.
Residuals clause removed. Escalated to counsel if the counterparty insists on it.
edits.issue: Residuals clause permits use of retained information

edits.find: obligations shall terminate upon expiration of this Agreement
edits.old: shall terminate upon expiration of this Agreement
edits.replace: shall continue for two (2) years after each disclosure, provided that obligations with respect to trade secrets continue for as long as the information remains a trade secret under applicable law
edits.comment: Obligations ended with the agreement. Aligned to a two-year tail after disclosure, with trade secrets protected for as long as they qualify.
edits.issue: Obligations end when the agreement expires

edits.find: one (1) year from the Effective Date
edits.comment: The one-year period runs from the Effective Date, not from each disclosure.

edits.find: Either party may assign this Agreement without the consent of the other party.
edits.replace: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other party's prior written consent, except to a successor to all or substantially all of the relevant business that assumes this Agreement.
edits.comment: Free assignment is not acceptable. Consent required, with a successor exception.
